description: US indie beauty brand founded in 2009, known for patented makeup brushes, brush-care tools and color cosmetics; directories list its affiliate program at 10% per sale, with the network reported as ShareASale by one directory and Impact by others.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky (profile updated March 11, 2024) lists Sigma Beauty (website sigmabeauty.com) on ShareASale at 10% per sale with a 90-day cookie; affiliateprograms.com independently lists the Sigma program at 10% commissions on all sales with a VIP tier above it.

Directories agree on a 10% base rate but conflict on the network and cookie: Brandid lists the program on Impact at 10% (up to 15% VIP), a 2018 program write-up also names Impact Radius with a 30-day cookie, Lasso lists 10-15% with a 2-day cookie, and Shopper's 4% figure is an outlier. The 10% base rate is recorded; the network is recorded as reported on both ShareASale and Impact. A creator platform (NewCollab) describes Sigma's direct creator route as gifting-led PR, so the commission route is the network affiliate program recorded here. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown; no creator count is published, so saturation is also unknown.

description: Indian beauty brand selling skincare, beauty and lifestyle products (35+ products across 9 categories, prices in rupees) whose own affiliate page runs a four-tier creator program through BixGrow, from a 15% base commission for nano creators up to 20% for professionals.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page (fetched) publishes creator tiers run through a BixGrow portal: Seedling nano creators (1K-10K followers) earn 15% base commission, Blossom micro influencers 18%, a Glow customer-referral tier 12%, and an Elite professional tier 20%, with automatic tier upgrades at published referred-sales thresholds, seasonal commission boosts and up to 22% on hero products. The recorded rate is the 15% base creator tier.

No earnings-cap or 'unlimited earnings' statement appears on the fetched program page, so the cap is recorded as unknown. No creator count is published, so saturation is also unknown. The Elite tier targets professional MUAs and salon owners, but the program's Seedling and Blossom tiers are creator tiers open from 1,000 followers, which is the route recorded here.

No earnings-cap or 'unlimited earnings' statement appears in the fetched program terms, so the cap is recorded as unknown. The program page states the Webgains program launched about three months ago, but a launch date alone is not creator-count evidence, so saturation is also recorded as unknown.
